title: Human Computer Interaction: Main Exam, 28 April 2021
department: Department of Information Technology / enterprise Computing
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Briefly explain the following terms as used in human computer interaction.
Virtual reality
Ergonomics
Interface metaphor
Human computer interaction
Briefly explain the user-centred design principles in HCI.
Describe prototyping in user interface development and explain two types of prototypes.
Write a short note on ergonomics, giving a relevant illustration.
Elaborate on the goals of human computer interaction in detail.
Briefly describe the role of human computer interaction in web design.
Explain the direct manipulation design principles, citing examples.
Explain any four principles of usability according to Norman, citing examples.
State and explain any five major guidelines in user interface design.
Explain any four types of user interfaces in human computer interaction.
Discuss user mental models and their role in HCI.
Write short notes on current innovations in human computer interaction.
Discuss how Fitts' and Hick's law models can be applied in human computer interaction design.
Discuss the applications of virtual reality.
Explain the major activities in user interface design.
Briefly explain the contribution of human computer interaction in software development.
Discuss the heuristic approach used in evaluating interactive systems.
